world_news_real.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
world_news_real.description: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack in the Tatarstan region, one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks on Russia since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

world_news_real.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
world_news_real.description: Frans Mathipa was shot while driving - we got access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.

world_news_real.title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
world_news_real.description: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall, bringing strong winds and heavy rain across eastern China including Shanghai.

world_news_real.title: Former Thai MP allegedly kills official and confesses on YouTube
world_news_real.description: Chalong Riewrang called a YouTube livestream to say he had shot a government official.

world_news_real.title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
world_news_real.description: The military operation against Hernando Forero Mosquera was carried out just days after Colombia's new president was sworn in.

world_news_real.title: World's oceans hit record-high July temperatures
world_news_real.description: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly fuelled by developing El Niño conditions, as wildfires continue to ravage western Europe.

world_news_real.title: India police fire tear gas at protesters seeking exam reforms
world_news_real.description: Thousands of students and job seekers have gathered in Jharkhand state, weeks after the "cockroach" protests took place in Delhi.

world_news_real.title: 'Body in suitcase' found in Australia turns out to be lifelike doll
world_news_real.description: Forensics revealed that the 'realistic' looking body was in fact not human.

world_news_real.title: Battle for Mali base has killed dozens of militants, army says
world_news_real.description: The army says it was involved in fierce fighting but disputes that Islamists took control of the garrison.

world_news_real.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
world_news_real.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.
